description: G11 coupled-cascade proof: a flip in overall-status-computer propagates to BOTH the /health JSON response AND the dashboard overall-badge class. This canary documents the two downstream impact surfaces that must go RED when the primitive is mutated.

injection.mutated_logic: ComputeOverallStatus({ok, ok, down}) wrongly returns 'ok' instead of 'degraded'
injection.effect: Two downstream surfaces are corrupted simultaneously

cascade_surfaces.evidence: AggregateHealthService.Aggregate() calls ComputeOverallStatus and writes result.Status into AggregatedHealth.Status, which is serialised verbatim in the /health JSON envelope

cascade_surfaces.field: HTML class attribute on overall badge element
cascade_surfaces.evidence: BuildDashboardHTML reads AggregatedHealth.Status and writes statusClass(overall) into the badge class attribute. A wrong overall status produces the wrong CSS class, making the dashboard badge misleadingly green.

trial_1.description: Flip overall-status-computer: inject wrong return on mixed input
trial_1.expected_outcome: Both /health JSON surface AND dashboard badge surface go RED
verification_commands: go test ./pkg/primitive/overall-status-computer/... → FAIL on 'mixed ok and down yields degraded'
go test ./pkg/domain/... → FAIL on TestComputeOverallStatus mixed ok+down
go test ./pkg/interface/http/... → FAIL on dashboard badge class assertion (if integrated)

trial_2.description: Flip route-service-matcher (task B3): inject wrong service-name extraction
trial_2.expected_outcome: Proxy routing surface AND health-by-service-name surface both go RED
